subject: Proposed MAP & sequencing for IllumiHealth pilot
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@illumihealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP & sequencing for IllumiHealth pilot

Alex — attaching a quick mutual action plan (MAP_IllumiHealth_v1.xlsx) that lays out the pilot evaluation milestones, gating criteria, and our recommended legal/procurement sequencing. High-level asks:

- Goal: 30-day technical evaluation (baseline accuracy + latency) followed by a 90-day pilot if metrics meet the acceptance thresholds.
- Dependencies we flagged: MSA signature OR approved interim terms, DPA execution, order form for pilot capacity (or temporary internal PO).
- Security evidence: SOC 2 report + data handling appendix to be shared with your security team.

Proposed sequencing (we can flex):
1) DPA signed (DocuSign) — allows secure test data exchange
2) Limited sandbox provisioned (no PHI) — start technical eval week 0
3) MSA negotiation in parallel; aim to execute within 3 weeks
4) Order form / PO for pilot capacity before production ramp

If procurement needs a different ribbon to run in order (e.g., MSA first), we can accommodate — calling this out so legal/procurement can pick the path they prefer.

Next steps: can you share procurement SLAs / preferred contract owner so we sync legal on prioritization? I can also route a DPA to DocuSign this week to unblock the sandbox.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attachments: MAP_IllumiHealth_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Alex Moore <alex.moore@illumihealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@illumihealth.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Jun 2025 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & sequencing for IllumiHealth pilot

Ben — thanks for this and the clear plan. A couple of constraints from our side that will affect sequencing:

- Our legal team typically requires an executed MSA before we approve a vendor to run anything on our network. They may accept a signed DPA earlier for data transfer, but their preference is MSA-first for outward-facing vendors.
- Procurement has a standard PO lead time of 3–4 weeks (internal approvals + budget release).
- We need access to your SOC 2 Type II report and an inventory of subprocessors before we can complete vendor risk assessment.

If we can get a DPA and the SOC 2 to start a constrained sandbox (no production data, isolated tenant), procurement may be willing to fast-track the PO once legal signals green. Otherwise, the MSA-first route will push the evaluation start by ~3 weeks.

I'll loop in the procurement owner, but for now please send the SOC 2 and any subprocessor docs. Can you also share a DocuSign DPA link so our legal can review in parallel?

Best,
Alex
Alex Moore | Head of Data Platforms | IllumiHealth
procurement@illumihealth.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@illumihealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Jun 2025 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & sequencing for IllumiHealth pilot

Thanks Alex — appreciate the constraints. A few suggestions from our legal/solutions side based on similar customers to keep momentum while meeting your controls:

- Share SOC 2 Type II and subprocessor list (we already have a public link; I'll attach a redline summary of our standard DPA).
- Offer: sign the DPA now (DocuSign) to enable secure test-data exchange. In parallel we can provide a locked sandbox tenant (anonymized test corpus) so your engineers can validate model behavior immediately.
- MSA redlines: propose a 21-day negotiation window. If IllumiHealth requires MSA-first regardless, we can accelerate by committing legal resources to a prioritized review path (we'll mark the case as expedited).
- Order form: we can accept a provisional PO to reserve pilot capacity and convert it to a final order after signature. That reduces procurement lead-time risk.

Attached is a short redline_summary.docx that maps common hook points legal asks for and our recommended concession set. Happy to do a 30-minute sync with legal + procurement to fast-track.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Head, Contracts & GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
attachments: redline_summary.docx (doc stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & sequencing for IllumiHealth pilot

Looping in a quick internal note before we send any formal DocuSign links to IllumiHealth:

- Legal: mark this as a prioritized review; I'll ask our contracts team to dedicate an attorney for a 48–72 hour turnaround on MSA redlines if IllumiHealth wants MSA-first.
- Offer a 30-day constrained pilot with a signed DPA + executed temporary PO (instead of final order form) to keep engineering work moving.
- Sales ops: Ben — please confirm pilot capacity (GPU-hours) and whether we can provision the sandbox without production data. We should also map acceptance metric owners in the MAP document so procurement can see clear success criteria.

If we commit to DPA + temporary PO route, we can likely start technical validation within 7–10 business days. If they insist MSA-first, update MAP timelines to start ~3 weeks later.

Laura
Laura Bennett | Director, Growth Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Moore <alex.moore@illumihealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@illumihealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & sequencing for IllumiHealth pilot

Alex — thanks for the quick feedback. Per our internal alignment (cc'd Laura and Karthik), next steps below and updated MAP attached (MAP_IllumiHealth_v2.xlsx):

Action items (aiming to keep momentum):
- Ben (me): send DocuSign link for DPA today and attach SOC 2 Type II and subprocessor inventory (links included).
- IllumiHealth procurement/legal: review DPA; if you confirm DPA-first we will provision an isolated sandbox (no PHI) within 5 business days.
- If IllumiHealth requires MSA-first, mark the MAP milestone "eval start" +21 days from MSA signature date; Redwood will prioritize legal review to compress to 14 days where possible.
- Procurement: provisional PO accepted to reserve pilot capacity; we'll convert to an order form upon signature.

DocuSign DPA: https://www.docusign.com/signing/ILL-DPA-2345
SOC 2 Type II: https://redwoodinference.com/security/SOC2-2024.pdf
Subprocessors: https://redwoodinference.com/security/subprocessors-2025.csv

Please confirm which path you prefer (DPA-first with constrained sandbox OR MSA-first) and we'll update the MAP milestones accordingly.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you started.
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
